blocks.text: addDoc adds a document to a collection with an automatically made id. The returned reference tells you that new path.

Use the Firebase Emulator Suite with the demo-reading-club project and Firestore on port 8080. Install the firebase JavaScript SDK in a local browser project. Run each full snippet on a fresh page. Keep the sample rules local.

blocks.title: Let Firestore choose an id

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `addDoc` creates a new document with a generated id each time it is called.
`connectFirestoreEmulator` sends this SDK instance to the local emulator address before database operations begin.

blocks.text: A new local sample document is created, and its generated id is logged.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Calling addDoc again makes another document. Use a chosen stable id when repeating a write should update the same record.
